summary: Rebuild plugin acquisition tools with the patched Go JOSE JWK parser.
userImpact: Plugin acquisition and signature verification keep their existing interfaces.

instructions: Adopt the newly qualified signed installer and manager image composition; existing published digests remain unchanged.

security: Pin github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 to v4.1.6 in both Cosign builds to address CVE-2026-116587 (GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q).
Inspect the emitted binaries for the fixed module version. Preserve the upstream 4096-bit JWK RSA modulus limit and all existing scanner thresholds and ignore policy.
knownLimitations: The security fix refuses JWK RSA moduli larger than 4096 bits. Exact-candidate cross-architecture and signature compatibility qualification remains required.
rollback: Prefer a qualified forward release; older toolchain images retain the vulnerable JWK parser.
validation: Installer and manager unit suites, dependency-security contracts, package/chart version discipline, chart validation, release policy, strict licenses and documentation checks pass locally.
Real Go JOSE tests verify supported RSA signing and reject oversized moduli and inconsistent private factors without raising the upstream 4096-bit limit.

Native ARM64 installer and manager images pass the unchanged HIGH/CRITICAL toolchain gate; lower-severity observations remain in scan artifacts. The same patched Cosign bytes verify real public Fulcio/Rekor candidate signatures and local blob-signature/tamper checks.
Protected exact-candidate cross-architecture and complete runtime qualification remains required before publication.

customerDocumentation.reason: The internal signature-tool dependency update requires no customer configuration or user-interface change.
